meta.title: Fish processing, packing and export from Egypt
meta.description: From the pond to the pallet: we farm and source fish, then wash, ice, grade, pack, inspect and export it with our own refrigerated trucks and cold stores.

hero.title: From the pond to the pallet, every stage handled by AZAFCO
hero.intro: We farm and source the fish, then wash, ice, grade, pack, inspect and export it ourselves, with our own refrigerated trucks, logistics and cold stores.
hero.imageAlt: Whole fresh fish on crushed ice in white boxes, with staff in hygiene clothing working behind

chain.title: Five stages, one agreed specification
chain.intro: Every order follows the same path, and each stage works to the specification we agree with you.

farming.title: Farming and sourcing
farming.text: We farm fish ourselves and also buy fish from other producers.
farming.alt: Aerial view of earthen fish ponds with aerators and palm trees

harvest.title: Harvest
harvest.text: The fish are netted and taken to our plant in Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh.
harvest.alt: Two workers pulling a net full of tilapia to the bank of an earthen pond

packing.title: Washing, icing and packing
packing.text: The fish are washed, iced, graded by weight and packed whole on ice, to the packing agreed for your order.
packing.alt: Gloved hands placing a whole tilapia into a crate of crushed ice on a steel table

inspection.title: Inspection
inspection.text: Checked against the agreed specification before the boxes are closed.
inspection.alt: A gloved hand holding a probe in iced water beside two whole tilapia

export.title: Export
export.text: Our own refrigerated trucks, then air or road freight.
export.alt: A worker moving a pallet of white boxes into a refrigerated truck at a loading dock

chain.plantMap: See our plant on Google Maps

logistics.title: Our own trucks and cold stores
logistics.intro: We run our own refrigerated trucks, logistics and cold stores. Every stage is handled by AZAFCO.

trucks.title: Refrigerated trucks
trucks.text: Our own refrigerated trucks move the packed boxes from the plant.

stores.title: Cold stores
stores.text: We run our own cold stores as part of our logistics.

freight.title: Air or road freight
freight.text: We ship by air and road to the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Lebanon, Qatar, Iraq and Syria. Europe is next in our plan.

agree.title: What we agree with you before each order
agree.intro: Tell us what your market needs. We confirm each detail with you before the order.

species.title: Species and weight grade
species.text: The species and the weight grade per fish. We supply other species on request.

form.title: Product form
form.text: Whole, fresh chilled and packed on ice.

packing.title: Packing and net weight
packing.text: The packing and the net weight per box, to suit your sales channel.

labels.title: Labels and destination
labels.text: Label content and language, and the requirements of the destination country.

closing.title: Tell us what your market needs
closing.text: Share the species, quantity, weight grade and destination. Our export team will review supply and commercial terms. Sending your requirements does not commit you to an order.

pending.temperature: Storage and transport temperature per product, with control points and records (owner to confirm before any figure is published)
pending.pack_formats: Validated pack formats (box types, net weights) and label options
